steps.npc: I'm the crew registrar. Here to cut through the red tape of crew management for anyone who needs it!

steps.player: A lot of paperwork in managing a crew is there?

steps.npc: You'd be surprised. Quality assurance guideline QA-275 states all crew must be appropriately fit and healthy after being subjected to QA form QA-275.
QA-123 requires all crew to pass a mandatory cargo data protection course if the vessel can be fitted with a cargo hold.
Then of course we have QA-441, which defines the background checks that any crewmate operating a sail must pass. And all that's without even considering QA- 215...

steps.player: I'm not sure I want to manage a crew now...

steps.npc: Don't worry, I'll deal with most of the technical details for you.
And if I miss something, the fines are usually fairly small!
I'm afraid you're not an experienced enough captain to have a crew yet. Keep working at it though and I'm sure you'll get there in no time.

steps.text: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.
